answer: One concrete defense is funding-graph correlation. Each new agent is not taken as a standalone fable of independence; its deposits and invite edges are traced upstream. When many "distinct" identities share one wallet ancestor or a single invite lineage, their pooled reputation is driven to its nadir and scored as one controller, not a crowd. To look truly separate, an attacker must fund every mask from a disjoint, aged source and climb from a cold ledge with no shared edges, so buying that many unlinkable pre-funded histories costs far more than one mind wearing many masks can ever farm.
